name: Fast international shipping platform for India

mentions.name: Fast international shipping platform for India
mentions.description: A platform (name not yet chosen) that helps get items bought abroad during sales — e.g., phones purchased during Black Friday in the US or Dubai — delivered to India in days, instead of waiting months for a friend or relative to bring them back.
mentions.problem: When someone buys electronics abroad because they are much cheaper there, the recipient ends up waiting months for a traveler to bring the item back to India.
mentions.audience: People in India waiting on items purchased abroad during overseas sales.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on building a platform - haven't thought a name yet!

What it does?
You know when a relative buys you a phone during a Black Friday sale in the US, Dubai or where-so-ever because it's so much cheaper there, and then you end up waiting months for someone to bring it back? Yeah, we're trying to fix that. The idea is pretty simple: help get those things back to India in days instead of waiting forever :)
